name: agent-libos-gui
description: Agent libOS self-contained internal desktop distribution
author: Agent libOS contributors

scripts.build: npm run clean:electron && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron-tests.json
scripts.desktop:stage: npm run build && uv run --project .. --frozen --group desktop --extra mcp python ../scripts/stage_desktop_runtime.py
scripts.desktop:dir: npm run desktop:stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never && uv run --project .. --frozen --group desktop --extra mcp python ../scripts/finalize_desktop_artifacts.py ../desktop-dist && uv run --project .. --frozen --group desktop --extra mcp python ../scripts/check_desktop_artifacts.py ../desktop-dist
